findings.description: When the resolved CA bundle path does not exist, the code now emits a warning instead of raising OSError, so the request proceeds with a missing certificate file.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a user passes verify='/nonexistent/ca.pem', or the default path is missing. Previously the check raised OSError immediately with a clear message. Now warnings.warn is called and execution continues to the TLS layer with a path that does not exist. The title only announces removing the extraction call, not changing this failure from an error to a warning, so this is an unannounced behavior change. Impact: the failure surfaces later as a less clear SSL/IO error, or the warning is missed and the error is obscured.
